func (l *Local) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (l *Local) Snapshot() LocalSnapshot

func (l *Local) Start(ctx context.Context, approved bool) (Credentials, error)

func (l *Local) Stop(ctx context.Context) error

func (l *Local) StopGeneration(ctx context.Context, generation uint64) error

func (s *Server) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (s *Server) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)

func New(config Config) (*Server, error)

func NewLocal(routes map[string]Route) (*Local, error)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/integration/llm/codec"
)

type Config struct {
	Authority string
	Token     string `json:"-"`
	Routes    map[string]Route

	Observe func(context.Context, Observation) error
}

type Credentials struct {
	Generation uint64 `json:"generation"`
	Address    string `json:"address"`
	Token      string `json:"token"`
}

type Local struct {
}

type LocalSnapshot struct {
	Generation uint64   `json:"generation"`
	Closed     bool     `json:"closed"`
	Stopping   bool     `json:"stopping"`
	Running    bool     `json:"running"`
	Address    string   `json:"address,omitempty"`
	Models     []string `json:"models"`
}

type Observation struct {
	Stage              string
	Alias              string
	From, To           codec.Protocol
	Converter, Quality string
	Steps              []codec.Step
	SHA256             string
}

type Route struct {
	Kind     provider.Kind
	Provider provider.Config
}

type Server struct {
}
